snippet_primary: "The worst shopping experience I've ever had. I tried 4 different cards from different banks – either the bank declines the transaction because it considers Gumroad suspicious, or the website itself says the card isn't supported. What exactly isn't supported? It's a regular international VISA card from a major European bank. How do you even operate like this?"
